thread:
Lina: Quick sync: we've got two modal patterns in Console right now (global alert modal + nested side-panel confirm). Need to standardize stacking, spacing tokens, and toast placement. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-modal-stack (see 'modal-stacking v2').
Marco: Noted. Current behavior: new modal renders with z-index 1200, side-panel at 1100. Toasts are global at 2000, which causes toasts to sit above modals. That's confusing.
Priya: Agree we should never have toasts on top of modals that require action. Toasts should be subordinate to blocking modals. Maybe lower toast z-index to 1000 and put modals at 1500+.
Lina: For stacking rules I'd propose: base surfaces 0-999, toasts 1000-1199, controls & panels 1200-1399, modals 1400-1599, overlays/menus 1600+. Thoughts?
Marco: That seems ok but keep consistent with existing token names: z-index--surface, z-index--toast, z-index--panel, z-index--modal, z-index--overlay. Let's not hardcode numbers in CSS; map tokens in vars.
Priya: Spacing interaction: when a modal opens over a table, we currently add 24px padding to the modal content on desktop, but the design tokens have space-4=16px and space-5=24px. Are we standardizing on multiples of tokens?
Lina: Yes, use spacing tokens only. For modal inner gutters use space-5 on desktop, space-4 on tablet, space-3 on mobile. No ad-hoc px.
Marco: Accessibility: focus trap currently allows focus to move to toast action (Undo). If toast is above modal, users can tab out of modal into toast. Must ensure focus remains trapped.
Priya: Two options: 1) make toasts non-focusable while a modal is open, or 2) position toast in DOM after the modal but visually below, with inert attribute while modal open. I prefer inert toggling.
DesignBot: Reminder: reduced-motion preference must be honored for modal entrance animations. Use prefers-reduced-motion media query.
Lina: Also we need to consider stacking of nested modals (confirm inside settings modal). UX says avoid >1 modal, but sometimes needed. Strategy: each nested modal increments token z-index--modal by +100 and adds a backdrop with higher opacity. Keep z-index math simple in docs.
Marco: CSS prototype for modal placement and toast behavior:
```css
:root { --z-toast: var(--z-index-toast, 1000); --z-modal: var(--z-index-modal, 1500); }
.modal { z-index: var(--z-modal); }
.modal--nested { z-index: calc(var(--z-modal) + 100); }
.toast { z-index: var(--z-toast); }
```
Also add .inert { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.95; }
```
Priya: QA note: when modal is open we should add aria-hidden="true" on the rest of the app container for screen readers, and set aria-modal="true" on the modal. Confirm that modal role is dialog with aria-labelledby.
Lina: Toast copy decisions: for destructive actions inside modal (e.g., delete confirmation), toast copy should explicitly reference context: 'Deleted dashboard "Growth metrics"'. Always include an Undo. Toast type: neutral (not success) when it's undoable.
Marco: Motion details: modal scale from 0.98 to 1 and fade-in; but with reduced-motion preference we should just fade or appear. Also ensure transform-origin is center for stacked modals so nested scale looks natural.
Priya: Edge-case: when a full-screen modal is open on mobile, toasts should be suppressed entirely (save small system messages). That avoids screen clutter.
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist: ensure focus trap, aria-modal, aria-hidden on background, keyboard dismiss on Escape, and focus return to triggering element. See /docs/a11y-modal-checklist.
QA-Bot: Regression test cases to add: modal stacking z-index, toast not receiving focus while modal open, reduced-motion behavior, spacing token conformity for modal gutters. Will add tickets.
Lina: Action items: Marco to update CSS tokens PR with z-index variables and inert toggle; Priya to draft a11y spec text; I'll update Figma to reflect tokens and show mobile suppression variant. We'll reconvene after PR review. :white_check_mark:
